description: Read authoritative ApexMaps documentation from the bundled apexmaps-skill knowledge base. Call with no arguments to list available files; call with `file` to fetch markdown. Use this for series datum shapes, joins, the geometry registry, projections, scales, drilldown, theming, or framework integration.

file.description: Filename to read (e.g. "SKILL.md", "data-format.md"). Omit to list available files.

name: apexmaps_get_reference
title: Get ApexMaps reference doc
